title: festuca ovina var. grandiflora
intro: Festuca ovina var. grandiflora, commonly known as tall fescue, is a perennial grass species belonging to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca ovina var. grandiflora include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can be used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
